footer.brandCopyLine1: Fine jewellery crafted into eternal elegance and enchanting memories.
footer.homeBrandDescription: Korkeila Helsinki is your premier jewelry advisor, specializing in bespoke engagement rings, wedding bands, and fine jewelry. Proudly designed and manufactured in Finland, we offer a curated, immediately available selection of natural and premium lab-grown diamonds. Every piece is engineered with precision prong symmetry. Whether you are looking for custom bespoke jewelry, rare Hamilton and Champagne yellow gold, or require a short-notice purchase, our Helsinki boutique delivers world-class craftsmanship with transparent value for money.
footer.ringBrandDescription: Explore our extensive collection of engagement and wedding rings, designed with technical perfection and Finnish heritage. Proudly cast and crafted in Finland, our advisor approach ensures you find the optimal balance of style, fit, and budget. Choose an ethically produced natural diamond or an exceptional lab-grown diamond, precisely set in recycled platinum 950 or 14K/18K gold. To guarantee your peace of mind, we offer a 6-month free resizing service and a flexible post-proposal exchange policy.
